implementation_notes.agent_runtime_eval: Runner and manual opt-in workflow implemented; actual live model evaluation not executed, no validated pass claimed.
implementation_notes.historical_v04_migration: not-implemented: complete reconciliation with previous 78-file offline ZIP
implementation_notes.live_insights_sync: not-implemented: requires owner-authorized Meta OAuth and verified endpoint permissions
implementation_notes.additional_languages: not-implemented: add a reviewed locale and tests before marking a new language supported
implementation_notes.paid_ads_execution: not-implemented: strategic advice exists but no live spending tools enabled
implementation_notes.ai_media_generation_adapter: not-implemented: creative briefs only; external generators must be separately opted in
implementation_notes.offline_pooled_baseline_builder: Computes pooled normalized rates from validated post rows; provenance labels and manual comparability review are user-supplied, not cryptographic/API attestations.
implementation_notes.account_state_mandatory_router: The primary skill and deterministic router enforce a pre-strategy gate; live LLM response evaluation has not been executed. Pure finished-copy tasks and immediate commercial safety rejections are excluded.
implementation_notes.account_state_classification: Median/MAD observational baselines only from nonmissing positive reach; no ghost percentage without manual sample and no 'healthy' universal ratio.
implementation_notes.brand_threshold_calibration: Proposed config only, never overwrite approved config; all defaults are editorial assumptions, derived entries need evidence.
implementation_notes.tagged_platform_knowledge_import: Owner-provided original source copied unchanged; tags originate in that file and are not independent Meta fact-checks.
implementation_notes.knowledge_age_audit: Offline date/tag parser and CI advisory implemented; unresolved tags require human review, automatic source refresh remains not-implemented.
implementation_notes.per_post_durable_profile_updates: Only an explicit --save writes stable, whitelisted post_defaults to a provided private brand.md. Ephemeral post choices are not saved without affirmative selection.
implementation_notes.persian_editorial_checklist: Human-language checks only; automated performance scoring is unsupported for Persian.
implementation_notes.external_source_rights_gate: Owner-asserted per-asset rights and watermark classification; research-only references excluded from publication; subtitles-only repost rejected. No legal or remote verification.
implementation_notes.availability_type_adapters: Offline physical_stock (legacy unchanged), digital_product, cohort_seats, consult_slots. Promotion means suggestion for human review, not a real sale; no live inventory/calendar API.
implementation_notes.phase5_synthetic_behavior_fixtures: Six independent bilingual synthetic fixtures with positive and forbidden human-review criteria; deterministic Python assertions cover existing offline engine/routing behavior.
implementation_notes.phase5_eval_preparation: Optional Codex CLI runner stages six isolated prompts and reviewer rubrics without model calls by default; answer key not injected.
implementation_notes.phase5_actual_model_behavior_pass: No actual LLM-generated transcript/graded response was executed. NOT_GRADED and human review required; do not confuse 199+ Python tests with model behavioral reliability.

module_status_scope: Statuses describe actual implemented executable coverage. 'implemented' modules may be offline only; see per-module scope in SKILL.md.
